statement: For N>=3,0<p<1,q>1, endpoint-wired versus free FK on an N-edge path has a positive marginal gap rho_N=(q-1)(1-a)a^N/(1+(q-1)a^N), a=p/(p+q(1-p)); rho_N tends to zero.
assumptions: The boundary partition wires only its two endpoints
proof_or_counterexample: Free forest weights factor into Bernoulli(a). Contracting endpoints reduces cluster count by one except when all edges are open, giving tilt 1+(q-1)1_all-open. Normalizing yields the stated gap. Exact union-find enumeration verified 360 configurations across 12 parameter/size comparisons.
remaining_gap: Independent referee. This refutes a finite-gap-to-positive-limit implication; it is not a counterexample on Z^d,d>=3.
